name: Avalara Cross-Border VAT
description: Global VAT & GST compliance, import duty calculations, and OSS/IOSS registration for European selling.
fullDescription: Avalara delivers enterprise-grade global tax automation solutions. For cross-border e-commerce merchants selling into Europe, the UK, Australia, and Canada, Avalara handles import customs duty tariffs, cross-border VAT registration, Import One-Stop Shop (IOSS) filings, and global GST remittances.
features: Automated customs duty and import tax calculations for landed-cost accuracy
European Union VAT registration, OSS, and IOSS compliance filing service
HS code classification engine using AI to accurately match tariff codes
Support for value-added tax compliance in over 190 countries globally
Pre-built integrations with major enterprise ERPs and e-commerce platforms
